fuel-monitoring.intro: Fuel is usually a fleet's biggest running cost. ITrackZen combines vehicle location, ignition status and fuel data so you can see where fuel is used, spot unusual drops and compare vehicles and drivers.
fuel-monitoring.image_alt: Fuel tanker being monitored with GPS fuel sensors

sections.title: What you can monitor
points: Fuel level over time, shown against location and ignition events
Refuelling events and consumption per trip, vehicle and period
Alerts for sudden fuel drops while parked or moving, where a fuel sensor is fitted
Idling time and its fuel impact, from ignition and movement data
Reports to compare vehicles, routes and drivers

sections.title: How the data reaches the platform
points: A fuel level sensor (for example analog, RS232 or RS485 types) or vehicle data (CAN bus) is connected to a compatible tracker
The tracker sends readings with its position to the ITrackZen platform
Accurate readings need correct installation and calibration for the tank shape

conditions: Fuel monitoring needs a compatible tracker and a fuel sensor or CAN data. Not every tracker model supports it.
Accuracy depends on the sensor, tank, installation and calibration. Readings can vary on slopes and with fuel movement.
Check the Supported GPS Trackers page for fuel-sensor-ready devices, or ask us to confirm your model.

faq.q: Do I need a special tracker for fuel monitoring?
faq.a: Yes. The tracker needs an input for a fuel sensor or access to the vehicle's fuel data. We can recommend compatible devices.
With a fitted sensor, sudden drops in fuel level can raise an alert with the time and place. It is an aid, not a guarantee, and depends on the installation.

driver-behaviour-safety.intro: Safer driving lowers accident risk, repair costs and fuel use. ITrackZen turns speed, movement and event data into clear alerts and reports, and adds camera-based alerts where AI dashcams are installed.
driver-behaviour-safety.image_alt: Bus driver monitored by an in-cabin AI dashcam

sections.title: Driving behaviour
points: Overspeed alerts by vehicle, driver or zone
Harsh braking, harsh acceleration and sharp cornering events, where the tracker reports them
Unusual stops, idling and route deviations
Driver identification with RFID or iButton readers, so trips are linked to a named driver

sections.title: Safety and emergencies
points: SOS or panic button alerts on supported devices
Crash or impact detection where the device supports it
AI dashcam alerts for driver distraction, drowsiness, phone use and smoking on supported cameras
Event video clips linked to GPS position and time

conditions: Behaviour events depend on the tracker's accelerometer and configuration. Entry-level devices may report fewer event types.
Camera detections need a compatible AI dashcam and good installation. Accuracy varies with lighting and camera position.
Tell drivers what is monitored and why, and follow your local privacy and employment rules.

faq.q: Can I see which driver was driving?
faq.a: Yes, when an RFID or iButton reader is installed and drivers use their tags, trips are linked to the driver.

faq.q: Do I need cameras for driver safety?
faq.a: No. Speed and driving-event monitoring work with GPS trackers. Cameras add visual evidence and in-cabin alerts.

alerts-geofencing-reports.intro: Know about problems when they happen and have the records to prove what happened. ITrackZen sends alerts, enforces zones and produces reports that suit managers, customers and auditors.
alerts-geofencing-reports.image_alt: Fleet manager reviewing geofences and reports on a dashboard

sections.title: Alerts
points: Overspeed, ignition on/off, stop and movement alerts
Route deviation and unauthorised-use alerts
Geofence entry and exit alerts
SOS, door and sensor alerts where hardware is fitted
Maintenance reminders by distance, engine hours or date

sections.title: Geofencing
points: Draw zones around depots, customer sites, ports, borders and restricted areas
Alert when vehicles enter, leave or stay too long
Use zones to measure dwell time and visit confirmations

sections.title: Reports
points: Trip, stop and route history reports
Daily, weekly and monthly summaries
Fuel, driver and utilisation reports where the data is available
Exports for sharing with management and customers

conditions: Alert and report availability depends on the plan, tracker model and sensors installed.
How alerts are delivered (for example on screen, email or push notification) depends on your account settings in the platform.

faq.q: Can I get alerts on my phone?
faq.a: Notifications can reach you through the platform and mobile app. Available channels depend on your account configuration.
Regular daily, weekly and monthly reporting is supported. Ask us which formats and schedules your plan includes.
